title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium – EGF/2026/001 BE/Cora
part_text: 9. Insists that expenditure on information and publicity be limited to what is necessary to inform eligible workers of the assistance available and to meet applicable legal requirements; calls on the Belgian authorities to avoid promotional expenditure beyond those purposes and to disclose the amounts spent on communication and publicity;
